description: This file defines a generic serializer class `ValueSerializer<TField, TValueSerializer>` used for serializing value types in the Orleans serialization framework. It implements the `IFieldCodec<TField>` interface and utilizes an injected serializer (`TValueSerializer`) that adheres to `IValueSerializer<TField>` to perform the actual serialization and deserialization logic. The class manages writing and reading value types to and from a buffer, marking value fields through `ReferenceCodec` methods, and writing structured data with start and end object markers.
